planner.description: Reasoning role (read/reason/git-metadata only, edit-denied): plan a task, rank or triage a backlog, and draft PRs (planning-tasks, prioritizing-work, generating-tickets, creating-pull-requests).

implementer.description: Implementer role: implement an approved plan on its feature branch in a dedicated worktree, verify, commit, and push (implementing-tasks).

reviewer.description: Fresh-context review of a live worktree change before a PR exists; review-only, never edits (reviewing-pull-requests, local mode).

pr-reviewer.description: Fresh-context merge gate on an open PR from the repo root; may merge and tear down only on a clean verdict with explicit approval (reviewing-pull-requests, remote mode).
